subject: READ statement
notes: Two goldens, each pinning a different half of GR24. l1_read_at_end_transfer pins a)'s STATUS conjunct ('10' on every at-end line), c) (the AT END phrase suppresses the USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR declarative — A2-ATEND=10 with no DF= line) and d) (with no AT END phrase the declarative runs — DG=10), with the '46' read as the live-declarative positive control. l1_read_at_end_ec pins a)'s EC conjunct ('and, if enabled, the EC-I-O-AT-END exception condition is set to exist') by reading FUNCTION EXCEPTION-STATUS (§15.33.1) inside the AT END imperative — the ONLY evidence for that conjunct anywhere, which is why it is named here rather than left as an unattached manifest entry. kb/Work PB810: GR24's actions apply only 'if the at end condition exists' - the '1x' class of 9.1.13.4, stated once in IoStatusClass.AtEnd; a '46' reached through GR21's pointer takes no AT END branch (pb810_read_46_takes_no_at_end).
